15import logging 

16 

17import torch 

18 

19from flag_gems import runtime 

20 

21logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) 

22 

23 

24def sparse_dim(self: torch.Tensor) -> int: 

25 """Return the number of sparse dimensions of ``self``. 

26 

27 Mirrors ``aten::sparse_dim(Tensor self) -> int``. The result is a plain 

28 Python int derived purely from layout metadata; it never depends on 

29 stored index or value data. The value is read directly from TensorImpl 

30 properties without re-dispatching the operator itself: once registered 

31 on the CUDA/sparse dispatch keys, an internal ``self.sparse_dim()`` (or 

32 ``torch.ops.aten.sparse_dim``) call would re-enter this implementation 

33 and recurse. 

34 

35 Semantics by layout (verified against native ATen on H20): 

36 - ``torch.strided`` (dense, non-nested): no sparse dimensions, 

37 ``sparse_dim == 0``. 

38 - ``torch.sparse_coo``: the leading dimension of the index matrix, 

39 ``self._indices().shape[0]``. Hybrid COO tensors (values with 

40 trailing dense dimensions) are covered by the same formula, and the 

41 result is independent of coalescing state and nnz. 

42 - Sparse compressed layouts (CSR/CSC/BSR/BSC): ``sparse_dim == 2`` by 

43 ATen contract, independent of the logical tensor shape. These are the 

44 only four layouts with a compressed index buffer, so they are 

45 recognized explicitly rather than falling through to a catch-all. 

46 - Nested tensors (``self.is_nested``) are rejected. A non-jagged nested 

47 tensor still reports ``torch.strided``, so it must be caught by 

48 ``is_nested`` before the layout dispatch; native ATen has no 

49 ``sparse_dim`` kernel on its ``NestedTensor<CPU|CUDA>`` dispatch key 

50 and raises ``NotImplementedError`` naming that key, which the 

51 implementation reproduces. Jagged nested tensors are rejected by the 

52 same guard (native also raises, through a different dispatch path). 

53 - Any remaining layout has no native kernel either and is rejected with 

54 a ``NotImplementedError``. No dispatcher key can be derived for such 

55 a layout, so the message names the layout itself rather than guessing 

56 a sparse backend. 

57 """ 

58 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME_GCU400 SPARSE_DIM") 

59 if self.is_nested: 

60 # Native aten::sparse_dim is not registered on the NestedTensor 

61 # dispatch key (verified on H20: NestedTensorCUDA for CUDA tensors, 

62 # NestedTensorCPU for CPU tensors). Reproduce the dispatcher's 

63 # message; only its build-independent prefix is emitted, since the 

64 # native message appends the full registered-backend list. 

65 backend = "NestedTensor" + str(self.device.type).upper() 

66 raise NotImplementedError( 

67 "Could not run 'aten::sparse_dim' with arguments from the " 

68 f"'{backend}' backend. This could be because the operator doesn't " 

69 "exist for this backend, or was omitted during the " 

70 "selective/custom build process (if using custom build). If you " 

71 "are a Facebook employee using PyTorch on mobile, please visit " 

72 "https://fburl.com/ptmfixes for possible resolutions." 

73 ) 

74 if self.layout == torch.strided: 

75 return 0 

76 if self.layout == torch.sparse_coo: 

77 return self._indices().shape[0] 

78 if self.layout in ( 

79 torch.sparse_csr, 

80 torch.sparse_csc, 

81 torch.sparse_bsr, 

82 torch.sparse_bsc, 

83 ): 

84 return 2 

85 # Unrecognized layout: native has no kernel for it either. There is no 

86 # dispatcher key to name here (for instance a nested tensor dispatches on 

87 # NestedTensorCUDA, not SparseCUDA), so report the layout instead of 

88 # guessing a sparse backend. 

89 raise NotImplementedError( 

90 "Could not run 'aten::sparse_dim' with arguments from an " 

91 f"unsupported layout ('{self.layout}'). This could be because the " 

92 "operator doesn't exist for this layout." 

93 ) 

94 

95 

96# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

97# torch_gcu dispatch adaptation (CPU-only torch, GCU on PrivateUse1) 

98# 

99# Platform facts this block compensates for (measured on the gcu400 target, 

100# torch 2.11.0+cpu + torch_gcu; GCU tensors carry PrivateUse1-family keysets): 

101# 

102# 1. aten::sparse_dim ships dedicated kernels only for the CPU/Meta sparse 

103# keys. Every other backend -- including the whole PrivateUse1 family -- 

104# resolves to the stale CompositeExplicitAutograd in TensorProperties.cpp, 

105# which rejects compressed layouts ("sparse_dim expected sparse or strided 

106# tensor layout but got SparseCsr"). A CSR/CSC/BSR/BSC tensor constructed 

107# directly on the GCU device therefore raises RuntimeError from 

108# t.sparse_dim() / torch.ops.aten.sparse_dim(t) even though the ATen 

109# contract (and the dedicated CPU kernels) say sparse_dim == 2. Registering 

110# this implementation on the live device keys fixes those dispatcher paths. 

111# 

112# 2. The generic KernelGen accuracy tests register sentinel/coexistence 

113# wrappers through torch.library on the CUDA-family dispatch keys 

114# ("CUDA"/"SparseCUDA"/"SparseCsrCUDA") -- the reference backend's keys. 

115# On this build those keys are dead: torch is compiled without CUDA, so no 

116# tensor ever carries them and such registrations never fire. The 

117# trampolines installed below forward to a kernel registered from python 

118# on the CUDA-family counterpart key when one exists (detected through 

119# torch.library._impls so the stale C++ composite is never picked up), 

120# which makes those registrations observable on this platform exactly as 

121# they are on CUDA. With no python kernel registered there the trampoline 

122# simply runs this implementation. 

123# 

124# 3. Sparse COO tensors cannot live on the GCU (no SparseCOO TensorImpl); 

125# gcu400/ops/_dimI.py materializes them on the CPU, so SparseCPU is the 

126# live sparse-COO key of this platform and receives a trampoline as well. 

127# 

128# The nested-tensor rejection key (NestedTensor<device>) is registered with 

129# the plain implementation: native has no kernel there either and raises 

130# NotImplementedError, which this implementation reproduces. 

131# 

132# Idempotent, and a no-op on a real CUDA host (the registrar's own 

133# CUDA-family registration then handles routing). Drop once the test suite 

134# is regenerated against flag_gems.device-derived dispatch keys. 

135# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

136_DISPATCH_INSTALL_FLAG = "_flaggems_gcu400_sparse_dim_dispatch_installed" 

137_SPARSE_DIM_LIBRARY = None 

138 

139 

140def _install_live_backend_dispatch(): 

141 global _SPARSE_DIM_LIBRARY 

142 if runtime.device.name == "cuda": 

143 return 

144 if getattr(torch, _DISPATCH_INSTALL_FLAG, False): 

145 return 

146 

147 import torch.library as torch_library 

148 

149 def _python_kernel_on(cuda_key): 

150 # Delegate only to kernels registered from *python* on the CUDA-family 

151 # key. Without the _impls guard, get_kernel would hand back the stale 

152 # CompositeExplicitAutograd that this torch build propagates to every 

153 # non-CPU/Meta key, which rejects compressed layouts. 

154 try: 

155 if f"aten/sparse_dim/{cuda_key}" not in torch_library._impls: 

156 return None 

157 return torch_library.get_kernel("aten::sparse_dim", cuda_key) 

158 except Exception: 

159 return None 

160 

161 def _make_trampoline(cuda_key): 

162 def _trampoline(dispatch_keyset, self): 

163 if cuda_key is not None: 

164 kernel = _python_kernel_on(cuda_key) 

165 if kernel is not None: 

166 return kernel.call_boxed(dispatch_keyset, self) 

167 return sparse_dim(self) 

168 

169 return _trampoline 

170 

171 device_key = runtime.device.dispatch_key 

172 registrations = ( 

173 (device_key, "CUDA"), 

174 ("Sparse" + device_key, "SparseCUDA"), 

175 ("SparseCPU", "SparseCUDA"), 

176 ("SparseCsr" + device_key, "SparseCsrCUDA"), 

177 ("NestedTensor" + device_key, None), 

178 ) 

179 

180 _SPARSE_DIM_LIBRARY = torch.library.Library("aten", "IMPL") 

181 installed_keys = [] 

182 for live_key, cuda_key in registrations: 

183 try: 

184 _SPARSE_DIM_LIBRARY.impl( 

185 "sparse_dim", 

186 _make_trampoline(cuda_key), 

187 live_key, 

188 with_keyset=True, 

189 ) 

190 installed_keys.append(live_key) 

191 except RuntimeError as error: 

192 logger.warning( 

193 "sparse_dim gcu400 dispatch install skipped for %s: %s", 

194 live_key, 

195 error, 

196 ) 

197 if not installed_keys: 

198 return 

199 setattr(torch, _DISPATCH_INSTALL_FLAG, True) 

200 # Later python registrations (flag_gems.enable / use_gems) may override 

201 # these entries; drop the duplicate-registration bookkeeping so they can. 

202 try: 

203 for live_key in installed_keys: 

204 torch_library._impls.discard("aten/sparse_dim/" + live_key) 

205 except Exception: 

206 pass 

207 

208 

209_install_live_backend_dispatch()
